page.overview:
Who is Joseph Joestar?

Purple }}Brown Dark green Stardust CrusadersLight blond Gray , Anime, ASB, EoH}}

OVA: Michael Bennett (English Dub)[http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=30002 François Siener] (French Dub)[http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=26252 Enrico Bertorelli] (Italian Dub)

As the grandson of Jonathan Joestar, Joseph is a natural-born Ripple user and eventual Stand user, wielding the psychic photographic Stand, Hermit Purple. Joseph meets the fantastic threats approaching him throughout his life with initiative and impressive ingenuity, battling Vampires, the Pillar Men, and malevolent Stand users.

At 18 years old, Joseph is a tall (195 cm/6'5"), handsome, and powerfully built man, with light eyes. He has short, dark, and unkempt hair, parts of his bangs shooting outwards in spikes, apart from which he closely resembles his grandfather Jonathan Joestar.

Also known as: Joseph, Old Joseph.
